tasks.title: Establish the Modern SaaS visual system
tasks.scope: Replace the existing theme tokens and shared component treatment in web/styles/app.css with a light-first slate, indigo, emerald, amber, and rose system. Preserve the existing semantic class names and all behavior. The app remains dependency-free; CSS is the project-native equivalent of the supplied Tailwind-oriented design brief.
tasks.verification: Confirm all semantic feedback variables remain defined, desktop and mobile media rules still exist, and no JavaScript behavior or knowledge-base file is changed.

tasks.title: Rebuild the shell hierarchy and responsive surfaces
tasks.scope: Make the shell communicate a clear product hierarchy: brand area, utility actions, assay context, left navigation, and spacious main workspace. Replace emoji navigation with accessible inline Lucide-style SVG icons without introducing a dependency. Apply the shared system to cards, controls, tables, forms, and high-density panels using existing hooks.
tasks.verification: Run the app and test desktop plus narrow viewport navigation, route switching, collapsed navigation, and a representative form interaction. Ensure controls retain accessible names and visible focus.

tasks.title: Build and adversarially verify the shipped UI
tasks.scope: Run the complete JavaScript suite and build the single-file artifact. Inspect the shipped artifact over HTTP at desktop and mobile widths, looking specifically for stale assets, horizontal overflow, unusable header actions, unreadable contrast, and broken navigation/icon semantics.
tasks.verification: The node test suite and build gates pass; the built artifact serves and renders the redesigned shell; no unrelated working-tree modification is included in the redesign diff.
